name: demo-stories
description: Customer stories slider of the 2026 Get a Demo flow (live #ap-demo-stories): quote copy beside a photo with a logo chip, then arrows, a progress line, dots and a View All link; one slide at a time, auto-advancing every 3 s (paused on hover or keyboard focus). Live: /get-a-demo-month-calendar/ and, with cta, /demo-confirmed/.

items.description: Slides. Each: quote (required), category, title, author, role, link_label, link_url, image, image_alt, logo, logo_alt, logo_w, logo_h.

cta.description: Show each story's link and the View All button (the thank-you page). Off, both stay in the markup but hidden, as on live.

heading.description: Visually hidden section heading (h2) and the slider's accessible name.

viewall_label.description: View All link text. Renders only with viewall_url.

quote_icon.description: Quote mark image URL. Empty uses the kit's.

autoplay_ms.description: Milliseconds between automatic slide changes (default 3000; 0 turns autoplay off; values under 1500 are raised to 1500). Autoplay pauses on hover, keyboard focus, touch, a playing video, an off-screen slider and a hidden tab, and never runs under prefers-reduced-motion.
